opening: I've been hearing voices, but there's no one there.
This has been going on for the past week, since my father died.
The voices talk about me in the third person.
The voices encourage me to hurt myself.
I keep getting unwanted thoughts that push their way into my head.
My father died of lung cancer.

opening.text: I've been hearing voices, but there's no one there. This has been going on for the past week, since my father died. My father died of lung cancer. The voices talk about me in the third person and encourage me to hurt myself. I keep getting unwanted thoughts that push their way into my head, and I've had trouble concentrating.
